name: Recall Home Memory
description: Where things are in this home, from Recall's 3D memory of it: the room, the furniture a thing is on or near, its height and its position in that room's map frame (metres, z up, floor at 0), and when it was last seen. Read-only. Off unless the owner turns it on. Never anyone's live position. Every message is screened by Llama Prompt Guard before anything runs.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: The owner's robot key (RECALL_ROBOT_KEY on the Mac)

skills.name: Where is it?
skills.description: Finds a remembered thing by name ("keys", "grey bag") and answers with a sentence and a data part: found, room, landmark, relation, height band, position [x, y, z] with frame_id "map", last_seen, confidence. Not found, or seen only unsurely: found false, with when it was last seen if known.
